description: Balance and activity of a Bitcoin address, with no key involved. When to use: reconciling a merchant wallet, or checking whether an address received funds and how active it is. Do not use: we do not label or risk-score addresses; for a single payment use btc_get_transaction. Returns: address, confirmed/unconfirmed balance, utxo count and total, tx count, last 10 transactions. Supports P2PKH (1..), P2SH (3..), bech32 (bc1q..), bech32m (bc1p..). Ultra-active addresses may return a degraded=true response under index load rather than hanging.
name: btc_get_address
